recent_en: TOPVISN recently declared an interim single-tier dividend of 1 sen per share for FY2026, with ex-date on 14 Sep 2026 and payment date on 6 Oct 2026. The company also announced a material litigation and disclosed changes in the interests of substantial shareholder and director DATUK LIEW HOCK NEAN and MADAM ANGELA LOO VOON PEI.
